With 20 documents, GPT-3.5-Turbo scores **75.8%** when the answer document is first and **53.8%** at its worst position. That worst case is **2.3 points below its closed-book accuracy of 56.1%**.

The document has no printed page numbers, so the page numbers below are counted from the start of the document.

- **Answer document first (Index 0): 75.8%** (Table 6, p. 19).
- **Worst position: 53.8%**, at Index 9, which is the 10th document, roughly the middle of the context (Table 6, p. 19). Table 6 reports only positions 1, 5, 10, 15 and 20, so this is the worst of the positions shown.
- **Closed-book: 56.1%** (Table 1, p. 5).

The paper states this comparison itself. It says that in the worst case, performance in the 20- and 30-document settings "is lower than performance without any input documents (i.e., closed-book performance; 56.1%)" (p. 5; also p. 2). Overall, accuracy falls by 22 points from the first position to the worst, consistent with the paper's statement that performance "can drop by more than 20%" (p. 5).
